subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a one-line digest and the requested behavior adds public config plus a new Telegram message lifecycle contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

options.title: Keep compact collapse summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep current progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track the requested checklist/finalization behavior as part of a cross-channel structured progress-card design instead of a Telegram-only config key.

recommendation.title: Design default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent current-main history on the Telegram progress-window and collapse-summary implementation this option would extend.
